report.summary: The report is well-sourced with accurate citations. All specific numbers, years, names, and financial figures match the cited pages. One minor issue: the statement about 'many unorganized players' in the infrastructure sector is not explicitly supported by the cited page drhp-p58, though it is mentioned elsewhere (drhp-p76). This does not affect the overall soundness. No untagged claims require attention.
